Heathbridge Capital Management Ltd bought 7,900 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.48% with the market. The institutional investor held 603,350 shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $24.86M, up from 595,450 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Heathbridge Capital Management Ltd who had been investing in Transcanada Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $37.84B market cap company.
